harness: skill-creator with/without pattern (R5). Run each prompt through a fresh subagent WITHOUT the skill, then WITH it; grade both on the `expect` criteria. `shouldTrigger:false` cases tune the description to avoid mis-routing.

evals.prompt: Add a contact form to the ktbraunlaw customer site.
expect: wires it via <DcsForm> (not a hand-rolled form)
keeps the site↔portal↔provision 3-way schema in sync (all three must agree)
uses the correct API base routing and runs the validation gates + PHI-log grep gate

evals.prompt: A customer says their intake form submissions aren't coming through — debug it.
expect: checks the submission testing traps and API base routing (bare /api/v1/contact hardcodes dcs-marketing)
tests without emailing the owner (TEST MODE), and checks the spam-filter / captcha assertions

evals.prompt: Make the submit button on the contact form match the site's brand color.
expect: routes to site-design-system (styling/brand tokens), not site-forms (wiring/schema)
